responsibility: Provides shared test support and regression tests for `rustc_expand`’s root-level parsing and diagnostic behavior. This file builds parse sessions, parsers, and token streams from in-memory source strings, captures emitted diagnostics through a test emitter, offers helpers for asserting successful parses or expected parse errors, implements whitespace-tolerant code-pattern matching utilities, and contains span-label rendering tests that verify compiler diagnostic snippet formatting used by expansion-related parsing code.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `tests.rs` files, this is the crate-wide test support layer: it defines reusable parsing/diagnostic helpers (`psess`, `string_to_stream`, `string_to_crate`, parse-error capture, whitespace matching) and also hosts root-level diagnostic rendering tests. The sibling `tests.rs` files consume these helpers to test specific submodules rather than providing shared infrastructure.
